title: Update now runs from a detached helper outside the service
goal: A manual or scheduled update requested from inside the running service stops, updates and restarts it through the lifecycle
acceptance: Failing test first: an update requested from inside a registered, running service is not refused with the stop-first blocker
The helper outlives the service it stops and records a receipt the dashboard reads after restart
Existing rehearsal, backup and rollback still apply
The helper updates the install folder from F-117-T01, never the development checkout
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-23; live Update now on NERV-01 remains.
